rv.q: But this witty and delightful adaptation of the 1984 film A Private Function strikes me as better than the original.
Betty Blue Eyes [is] the most thoroughly English and charming new musical in the West End for a very long time.

Whether this particular mix of charm, nostalgia and comfortingly familiar comedy tropes leavened by a strong, if not hit-laden score, will bring back its loyal audience remains to be seen. I suspect they, like me, may look forward to something rather more meaty.

A truly spectacular cast and clever direction brings new life to a show that already boasted wonderful writing and marvellous songs. Guaranteed to make you snort with laughter, this utterly charming production is never boar-ing.
A heart-warming, glorious romp of a show that will leave you humming all the way home.
